notes: VERSION: version of record (Laser Photonics Rev. 19, 2401092) with the Supporting Information (docx text, cited by section). Row a = 1547.1 nm, the best point. Vpi 2.1 V from a 10 kHz triangular sweep (Table 1: 2.1 V @10 kHz); the paper warns that near-DC sweeps can over- or under-estimate Vpi because of the photorefractive effect (p.4). EO S21 (Fig. 3(b), 110 GHz LCA) shows no -3 dB crossing up to 110 GHz, so 110 is a bound equal to the measurement limit; the plotted trace is normalised and rises to about +4 dB; Table 1 lists the roll-off as 0 dB at 110 GHz (not entered). Simulated 3 dB bandwidth 235 GHz is on row shen2025-design. Static ER 27.5 dB here; minimum ER over the slow-light range is 12.7 dB at 1546 nm (supplement Section 12, Fig. S14). Dynamic eye ER 3.3, 2.1, 1.5 dB at 120, 150, 180 Gbps NRZ (Fig. 4(b-d)); these are on shen2025-sys. Optical loss: the supplement calls the on-chip loss wavelength dependent, 5.8 dB minimum and 16.9 dB maximum over 1544.9-1547.1 nm, mean 9.3 dB (supplement Section 7, Fig. S9); the paper does not say whether the grating couplers are included, so il_onchip_db 12.4 dB is entered with scope undefined, read from Fig. S9 (supplement docx image, transmission vs wavelength, 1544.9-1547.1 nm), about +/-0.3 dB (trace end at 1547.1 nm). The readings at the other wavelengths are about 10.2 dB (1546.92 nm, b) and about 15.3 dB (1546.7 nm, c), each about +/-1 dB on a steep slope, and about 13.0 dB (1546.1 nm, d); b and c are in notes only; 1535 nm (e) is outside the plotted range. Not reported: signal/ground widths, SiN waveguide width, arm spacing, cladding, temperature, optical power. Supplement figures are embedded in source.docx (word/media); Fig. S9, S12 and S14 are raster images and were read; Fig. S8 and S11 are EMF and were not rendered.
